item.subject: science
item.stem: Priya measures the length of her new geometry box using a 30 cm scale. Which method will give her a correct and reliable measurement?

options.A: She places the scale touching the box along its length, reads it with her eye directly above the end mark, and writes the number with the unit.
options.B: She holds the scale slightly above the box and reads it from the side, then writes the number with the unit.
options.C: She places the scale touching the box but only writes the number, since the unit is obvious.
options.D: She places the scale touching the box and reads it while sitting to one side, then writes the number with the unit.
